snippet.title: Al'ulA | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Al'ulA is a first-person narrative non-euclidean puzzle game, created by a team of french students!

Discover the mysteries of a myserious fractal dimension, rotate your environement using a alien artefact and meet otherworldy entities!
Think, Rotate, Escape ✨🌌👁


Follow @playlula on Instagram, TikTok & X!
